paragraphs: Yitzchak son of Yonatan; [Jerusalem Talmud Niddah, end of chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Niddah.2.7.7). Rabbah son of Yonatan; Yoma 46a as cited by Hyman. See [Yoma 47a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.47a.9).[^2][^1]

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi names Yitzchak bar Yonatan. The occurrence Hyman cites for Rabbah bar Yonatan at Yoma 46a remains unconfirmed. Hyman assembles both patronymics under Yonatan.

In the linked Yoma passage, Rabbah bar Yonatan cites Rabbi Yechiel on the benefit of arsan for the sick. [Nedarim 41b:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.41b.2) gives Rav Yechiel and quotes Rabbi Yonatan separately to explain arsan.
